##### Project general facts

Bayz 102 is a premium residential development by Danube Properties, located in the prestigious Business Bay district. The project offers an extensive selection of residences, including studios, 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, and exclusive penthouses, all designed to combine contemporary luxury with exceptional functionality. Positioned in one of Dubai’s most dynamic urban destinations, Bayz 102 provides residents with breathtaking views of Burj Khalifa and seamless access to the city's key business, leisure, and entertainment hubs. The development is conceived as a lifestyle destination where sophisticated architecture and thoughtfully planned living spaces come together to create an elevated residential experience.

The project features more than 40 luxury amenities designed to cater to every aspect of modern living. Residents can enjoy unique facilities such as a rooftop cinema, wellness club, indoor gym, aquatic gym, business center, health bar, and dedicated recreational areas for families, children, and pets. Select residences also benefit from private swimming pools, adding an extra layer of exclusivity and comfort. The carefully curated amenity offering creates a resort-style atmosphere that supports wellness, relaxation, social interaction, and productivity, making Bayz 102 a self-contained community within the heart of Dubai.

The interiors are finished to an exceptional standard using premium materials and luxurious detailing throughout. Design features include high-quality decorative kitchen panels, black Marquina marble finishes, Volakas white marble surfaces, brushed gold cladding details, luxury grooved doors with golden accents, pearl white finishes, designer carpets, and sophisticated carbon fiber elements. The residences include fully equipped kitchens with appliances and are delivered fully furnished with premium Italian Dolce Vita furniture, creating elegant and ready-to-move-in living spaces that embody contemporary luxury and refinement.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay, Dubai, can be confusing due to its name. However, it’s not just office spaces and buildings. There are hotel towers, amazing restaurants and wonderful residential properties here as well. It is known to be a very stylish and up-to-date in the latest trends and gadgets kind of community. The life here is face-paced. 

Business Bay is on the south side of Downtown Dubai. This area usually hosts plenty of events to keep things lively. There are music festivals, Mother’s Day celebrations, New Year’s celebrations and many others as well. The lifestyle that Business Bay offers has many advantages.

Famous and international schools, medicals, supermarkets, banks and finance centers are a few minutes from your space. The place simply elevates your life standard and way of living with easy and intuitive options in the proximity. Come and seek refuge in this wonderful place full of potential elements of pleasures, success and fun.
